notes.title: 2025.1 Update
notes.notes:
Added player movement icons.

Updated some weapon and item icons.

Try to fix: There is a chance that the map will be incompletely generated after deleting the file.

notes.title: Last update for this year. Welcome to 2025!
notes.notes:
Main updates:

Updated the textures of some scene buildings and wreckage.

Updated some weapon and equipment icons.

Reduce the size of players and enemies, speed up all units.

Increased some mission rewards, reduced the difficulty of some main missions.

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/38941270902026896/61DAF6A887A3023D4DCFD60484ADA3BFFE6A0E43/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false




Optimization and repair:

Added the "Open archive folder" function in the settings to facilitate quick feedback of problems.

Optimized the flashing prompt effect of the inner circle star map node.

Optimized the priority stacking logic when picking up items.

Optimized the information display rules in the star system details.

Fixed the process errors in some tasks.

bug: Some loot generation does not follow the safety level, causing the task to get stuck.

Some laser weapons display the wrong caliber.

Added sound effects to the "Pick Up All" button.

bug: When loading weapons with the weapon shortcut bar turned on, the number of ammunition is not refreshed immediately.

The position of the ship change button is adjusted, Adaptive resolution.

Clicking on the star map will no longer penetrate the scene.

The preparation interface will be exited before jumping.

The empty state of the scan window is optimized.

The drag operation of store-related items is prohibited, including the product bar and the recipe bar.

The store purchase button is connected to multiple languages.

Bug: The file is not automatically deleted when the version is updated.

Remove some invalid logs.

notes.title: Floating Star 2024.11 Update
notes.notes:
Game artist 机械的圣地 has Joined the team!


Main Changes:

Add frame rate limit to reduce lag.

Add circle prompts for interactive objects in the scene, including loot boxes, salvageable objects, shops, etc.

You can now interact with loot boxes by clicking the tips in scene.

Replace loot box textures and add outline effects.

Replace some space building textures.

Optimize player movement logic: trigger events immediately while moving; prohibit movement and other operations when dialogue pop-ups exist.

Other logic optimizations.
